# Webflow "User Guide"

[![Image 3: Pat Szot](https://cdn.dribbble.com/users/5085966/avatars/normal/acc69f2fdb31dc31dbe30dfcb000e7c1.jpeg?1675577475)](http://dribbble.com/patszot)

[Pat Szot](http://dribbble.com/patszot)

[Follow](http://dribbble.com/patszot/followers)[Following](http://dribbble.com/patszot/followers/patszot)

*   [](http://dribbble.com/signups/new "Save shot")

[Get in touch](http://dribbble.com/signups/new "Get in touch")

At Webflow, one of the first executions folks do when joining the brand team is to build a "User Guide". This document is intended to be an extra point of reference for work and communication styles. User Guides can be a literal document, image, but folks are encouraged to build it in Webflow. When I first joined the team my guide was weak sauce but I'm stoked how some digging in and figuring it out turned out with this version.
